marks.q: The Company had a positive finish to the year and expects to report FY25 ahead of market expectations* with revenue of US$13.2 million (FY24: US$11.4 million) and adjusted EBITDA** of US$2.9 million (FY24: $1.9 million).

This growth has continued in 2025, and as announced on 2 February 2026, Pathos delivered a strong financial performance in the financial year ended 31 December 2025 ("FY25"), ahead of market expectations at the time*, with expected revenue of US$13.2 million (FY24: US$11.4 million) and adjusted EBITDA** of US$2.9 million (FY24: $1.9 million).

The Board has confidence that management will meet market expectations, accelerating business development in the year ahead.  Our investment in expansion of the business is having the expected impact which includes our forecast annual results being weighted towards the second half of the year.
The revenue visibility from this contract also further underpins management confidence in achieving market expectations for FY2026.

The work undertaken and the investments made during H1 2026 has positioned Pathos for accelerated growth in the second half of the year and the Board remains confident in meeting market expectations for the FY 2026***.
This momentum further underpins management's confidence in at least meeting market expectations* for the current financial year.
marks.gnote: early signal: first step up in tone

marks.q: The Board therefore remains confident in the Company meeting, or being slightly ahead of, full year market expectations2 and is very optimistic about the future.
This growth has continued in 2026, and the Pathos board remains confident in the Company meeting the upgraded full year market expectations* and is very optimistic about the future.

disc.vs: H1 R Sep-26 · award RNS Mar-26 (listed Dec-25, no year-earlier document)

lines.text: Sep-26: “meeting, or being slightly ahead of, full year market expectations” → Oct-26: “meeting the upgraded full year market expectations”; on profit the EBITDA expectation is unchanged, so the “slightly ahead” is gone

“upgraded” expectations are revenue only: Sep-26 “Revenue of US$14.0 million and Adjusted EBITDA of US$4.0 million” → Oct-26 “Revenue of US$15.0 million and Adjusted EBITDA of US$4.0 million”, implied margin lower
Sep-26 footnote carried “2027: Revenue of US$15.3 million” and a run-rate “over 75% of the current 2027 revenue market expectation” → Oct-26 footnote gives FY26 only
FY26 revenue expectation raised from US$14.0m to “Revenue of US$15.0 million”
